Subject: Handoff: Velox AI onboarding & office hours plan

Team —

Handoff for Velox AI (deal RDI-8421). Quick context: they signed the Dedicated pilot last week; production cutover is gated on a short security checklist and a final SLO review. Primary contacts: Sophie Dunne (implementation lead) and an internal engineer alias (implement@veloxai.com).

Key goals for the next two weeks:
- Run two 60-minute enablement sessions: runtime walkthrough + integration patterns.
- Stand up weekly office hours (30m) for 4 weeks to triage integration questions.
- Deliver a one-page implementation checklist and a recording after each session.

Asks from me: can Marissa own the first two sessions (agenda attached) and Naomi/Ben rotate office-hours coverage? Monica, please prepare the checklist and a short pre-read we can send to the customer.

Attachments: velox_session_agenda.pdf (proposed agendas), implementation_checklist.xlsx (draft).

Timeline (proposed):
- Wed Apr 21: pre-read to customer + confirm session times
- Thu Apr 22 & Tue Apr 27: 60-min sessions (Walkthrough, Integration patterns)
- Weekly office hours starting Apr 29 (Wednesdays)

I'll loop in Sophie after we lock times.

Thanks —
Connor

Subject: Re: Velox AI onboarding & office-hours rollout plan

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for the quick chat yesterday. Per Connor's note, we proposed two hands-on sessions plus weekly office hours. Proposed session times (all PST):
- Session A: Thu Apr 22, 10:00–11:00 — Runtime walkthrough, KV / caching patterns
- Session B: Tue Apr 27, 14:00–15:00 — Integration and rollout checklist, toggles

Please let me know if those windows work for your team or share alternatives. Attached is a short agenda for each session (Attachment: velox_session_agenda.pdf).

We'll send a 2-slide pre-read and the implementation checklist before Session A. Office hours cadence: starting Apr 29, weekly Wednesdays 09:30–10:00 PST for four weeks. If you prefer a different cadence we can adapt.

Quick notes on attendees: please include 1 engineer + 1 product owner per session so we can cover end-to-end runbook items.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole | Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
